dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「昼飯を外で食べるってのも、なかなかオツな
　ものだな」
dialogues.en: "It's odd for you to invite me out of school for lunch."
dialogues.text: "It's odd for you to invite me out of school for lunch."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「まあな。ちょっと前に、うまい定食屋を見つ
　けていつか紹介したいと思ってたんだ」
dialogues.en:
"I guess. Recently, I saw an interesting-looking set-lunch
advertised, and thought I'd introduce it around."
dialogues.text:
"I guess. Recently, I saw an interesting-looking set-lunch
advertised, and thought I'd introduce it around."

dialogues.jp:
時々だが、構内でなく外へ食事をしにいくこと
がある。学校では特に外出を禁じていないため、
何人かはそういう昼休憩を過ごしている。
dialogues.en:
From time to time, I'd head out of campus to eat. The school
doesn't prohibit it, so lots of students spend their lunch
break outside.
dialogues.text:
From time to time, I'd head out of campus to eat. The school
doesn't prohibit it, so lots of students spend their lunch
break outside.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「杉並も誘ってやればよかったのに」
dialogues.en: "You should've asked Suginami as well."
dialogues.text: "You should've asked Suginami as well."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「誘ってはみたが、あいつ『今日は風が悪い』
　とかなんとか訳のわからないことをいいやがっ
　てな」
dialogues.en:
"I did, but he muttered something like "Today's winds are a
bad omen", and declined."
dialogues.text:
"I did, but he muttered something like "Today's winds are a
bad omen", and declined."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Winds, huh..."
dialogues.text: "Winds, huh..."

dialogues.jp:
工藤は、くすりと鼻で｛わら／嗤｝いながら、さらさらの
髪の毛をわしゃわしゃと指で｛す／梳｝く。
dialogues.en: Kudou pushed his hair up with his palm, laughing a little.
dialogues.text: Kudou pushed his hair up with his palm, laughing a little.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「ま、どっちにしてもさっさといかないと、時
　間がなくなるな」
dialogues.en:
"Well, if we don't get moving now, we won't have enough
time."
dialogues.text:
"Well, if we don't get moving now, we won't have enough
time."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Right."
dialogues.text: "Right."

dialogues.jp: 俺と工藤は連れ立って、並木道へ足を向ける。
dialogues.en: Walking together, we strolled down the Sakura Avenue.
dialogues.text: Walking together, we strolled down the Sakura Avenue.

dialogues.jp: 「ん、あれは……」
dialogues.en: "Hm, that's..."
dialogues.text: "Hm, that's..."

dialogues.jp: 前からやってくるのは、月城じゃないか。
dialogues.en: That figure in front of us, isn't that Tsukishiro?
dialogues.text: That figure in front of us, isn't that Tsukishiro?

dialogues.jp: 「やあ、月城」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Tsukishiro."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Tsukishiro."

dialogues.jp:
月城が、俺達の前までやってきて、ぺこりと頭
をさげる。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro, who had been walking in our direction, reached
us and bowed.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro, who had been walking in our direction, reached
us and bowed.

dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんだ？　まさか、遅刻か？」
dialogues.en: "What happened? You weren't late, were you?"
dialogues.text: "What happened? You weren't late, were you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「おいおい、朝倉じゃないんだから……」
dialogues.en: "Oy oy, now that's the pot calling the kettle black..."
dialogues.text: "Oy oy, now that's the pot calling the kettle black..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「俺だって、こんなに遅刻はしないっての」
dialogues.en: "Even if I was, I wouldn't be THIS late."
dialogues.text: "Even if I was, I wouldn't be THIS late."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……遅刻です」
dialogues.en: "...I came late."
dialogues.text: "...I came late."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「ありゃ、ホントにだったのか」
dialogues.en: "Whoa, it's true."
dialogues.text: "Whoa, it's true."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……用事があって」
dialogues.en: "...I had things to do."
dialogues.text: "...I had things to do."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「用事？」
dialogues.en: "Things?"
dialogues.text: "Things?"

dialogues.jp:
月城はこくんと頷いて、鞄の中から、ビニール
袋を取り出して見せてくれる。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro nodded, and opened the vinyl bag she was carrying
to let me look.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro nodded, and opened the vinyl bag she was carrying
to let me look.

dialogues.jp: 「肥料……。ああ、あの草の」
dialogues.en: "Fertilizer...? Ah, for the plant."
dialogues.text: "Fertilizer...? Ah, for the plant."

dialogues.jp: こくんと頷き、また袋を収める。
dialogues.en: Another nod, as she zipped the bag back up.
dialogues.text: Another nod, as she zipped the bag back up.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、あの草って」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean by "the plant"?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean by "the plant"?"

dialogues.jp: 月城が、俺の顔に視線を向けた。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro's gaze turned to me, worry on her face.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro's gaze turned to me, worry on her face.

dialogues.jp: 「ああ、別になんでもない」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, it's nothing, don't worry about it."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, it's nothing, don't worry about it."

dialogues.jp:
俺がそう答えると、月城は大きく息を吐いて安
堵の表情を見せる。
dialogues.en:
As I answered, she let out a held breath, the relief obvious
on her face.
dialogues.text:
As I answered, she let out a held breath, the relief obvious
on her face.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「この子の大事な秘密ってことか」
dialogues.en: "A secret that's important to this girl, I suppose."
dialogues.text: "A secret that's important to this girl, I suppose."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、そんなところだ」
dialogues.en: "Well, you could say that."
dialogues.text: "Well, you could say that."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「それなら、まあ……深く聞くのはやめよう」
dialogues.en: "If that's the case, then... I won't delve any further."
dialogues.text: "If that's the case, then... I won't delve any further."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……先輩、サヨナラ」
dialogues.en: "...Senpai, farewell."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai, farewell."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、そう言ってもう一度ぺこりと頭を下げ
ると、すたすたと学校に入っていった。
dialogues.en:
As she spoke, she nodded again, then walked at her usual
brisk pace to school.
dialogues.text:
As she spoke, she nodded again, then walked at her usual
brisk pace to school.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「遅刻をしてでも、守りたい何かがあるってこ
　とか」
dialogues.en:
"So basically, she was late because she had to protect
something?"
dialogues.text:
"So basically, she was late because she had to protect
something?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Something like that..."
dialogues.text: "Something like that..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉も、そういうカッコイイ理由で遅刻をす
　るなら、いいんだろうけどな」
dialogues.en:
"Too bad your reasons for tardiness aren't as glorious as
that."
dialogues.text:
"Too bad your reasons for tardiness aren't as glorious as
that."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「大きなお世話だ」
dialogues.en: "I do that sometimes."
dialogues.text: "I do that sometimes."

dialogues.jp:
そんなとき、ひとりの女の子が目の前をふらふ
らと歩いていた。
dialogues.en:
Just then, a lone girl was walking towards us, tottering
slowly.
dialogues.text:
Just then, a lone girl was walking towards us, tottering
slowly.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「すや〜」
dialogues.en: "Zzz~"
dialogues.text: "Zzz~"

dialogues.jp:
よたよたと千鳥足で歩きながら、木にぶつかり
方向転換。壁にぶつかり方向転換。
dialogues.en:
The way she was sleepwalking, she was on a collision course
with a wall or a tree.
dialogues.text:
The way she was sleepwalking, she was on a collision course
with a wall or a tree.

dialogues.jp: 確か、あんなオモチャあったよな。
dialogues.en: And of course, she was playing with that toy.
dialogues.text: And of course, she was playing with that toy.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「すや〜」
dialogues.en: "Zzz~"
dialogues.text: "Zzz~"

dialogues.jp: ──ゴン
dialogues.en: ──*Kon*
dialogues.text: ──*Kon*

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩は、校門の壁にぶつかり、そのままずる
ずると地面にずり落ちる。
dialogues.en:
Moe-senpai eventually collided with a wall, and fell to the
floor.
dialogues.text:
Moe-senpai eventually collided with a wall, and fell to the
floor.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「むにゃむにゃ……、シャッキリポンといいお
　味……」
dialogues.en: "*mumble mumble*..... That shakripon tastes good..."
dialogues.text: "*mumble mumble*..... That shakripon tastes good..."

dialogues.jp:
先輩は、そのままその場で気持ちよさそうに眠っ
てしまった。
dialogues.en: Senpai then remained there, in a seemingly peaceful slumber.
dialogues.text: Senpai then remained there, in a seemingly peaceful slumber.

dialogues.jp:
「──こういう遅刻の仕方より、なんぼかマシ
　だと思うんだが、どうか」
dialogues.en: "--And nothing I can do would ever beat this."
dialogues.text: "--And nothing I can do would ever beat this."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「それは認めてやろう」
dialogues.en: "That, I can agree with."
dialogues.text: "That, I can agree with."

dialogues.jp: ったく。萌先輩を尊敬しますよ、ホント。
dialogues.en: Whew, Moe-senpai is really a fearsome opponent.
dialogues.text: Whew, Moe-senpai is really a fearsome opponent.

dialogues.jp: ◆大事な秘密◆
dialogues.en: ◆Imporant Secret◆
dialogues.text: ◆Imporant Secret◆

dialogues.jp:
工藤と一緒に、外にメシを食いに出かけようと
したら、並木道を月城がやってきていた。どう
やらこの時間に登校してきたらしい。
dialogues.en:
I went out of campus with Kudou to eat lunch, and we bumped
into Alice at the Sakura Avenue. She seemed to be heading to
school.
dialogues.text:
I went out of campus with Kudou to eat lunch, and we bumped
into Alice at the Sakura Avenue. She seemed to be heading to
school.

dialogues.jp:
月城は、あの草のために肥料を買いに行ってい
たらしく、遅刻をすることよりも、あの草の方
が大切ということなんだろう。
dialogues.en:
Apparently she was late because she went to buy fertilize
for the plant... it's really special to her.
dialogues.text:
Apparently she was late because she went to buy fertilize
for the plant... it's really special to her.

dialogues.jp:
その後、いつものように、だらしなく校門のそ
ばで寝ている萌先輩を見つけた。俺も遅刻常習
者だが、こうはなりたくないな……。
dialogues.en:
After which, we found Moe-senpai peacefully sleeping next to
the school gates. Even myself, the Tardiness King, can't
beat that...
dialogues.text:
After which, we found Moe-senpai peacefully sleeping next to
the school gates. Even myself, the Tardiness King, can't
beat that...
